scope: Bounded official reference and public-landmark preflight, not complete national postcode-block assignment

dataset_probe.query_order: Numeric n only orders this observation; no stable source object identity is established.
dataset_probe.crs_policy: Point platform metadata and latitude/longitude labels are not a provider CRS, position-accuracy or building-identity statement.

upon the request of the iGA
terms_probe.scope_policy: Portal terms cover this site and linked iGA-owned sites; the separately linked 2025 government license covers officially published government open datasets. Neither makes every government document or controlled certificate open data.

reference_probes.edition: 01/2024; one-page addressing conventions, not current complete allocations
Version 1.0, 20 May 2025; all five bilingual pages text-reviewed

rights_review.positive_basis: The portal links the Bahrain Open Government Data License v1.0, 20 May 2025. It provides a reuse basis for officially published government open datasets, including eligible datasets on other government sites, not only this portal.
rights_review.coexisting_terms: The October 2025 portal terms and linked May 2025 license coexist. Preserve both and review applicability, disclaimer and removal mechanics before release; do not silently select the shorter obligations.
rights_review.metadata_license_null: Blank per-dataset license fields are not proof of no rights: the portal-linked governing documents remain relevant. They do not prove missing postcode-block data exists or authorize a new distribution destination.
rights_review.authority_gates: No account creation, paid certificate/map, contract acceptance, subscriber/CPR/title query, new repository/public destination or production deployment without explicit approval.

authority_boundaries.postcode: Never infer a postcode from an in-range numeric block, equal digits, landmark name, point or metadata envelope.
authority_boundaries.geometry: Dataset metadata bbox is an envelope, not a postal polygon. Point, official, derived, virtual and none remain distinct.
authority_boundaries.building: Landmark coordinates and block labels are not civic building IDs or address-building crosswalks.
authority_boundaries.po_box: UPU P.O. box format is non-spatial routing evidence, not a subscriber identity, home or catchment.
authority_boundaries.completeness: All 27 current landmark rows, a postal statistics catalog search, or a services directory cannot satisfy the unchanged complete national M2_assignment definition.
